name: Temporary Residence for Study Purposes (long-stay visa D/AS)

requirements.blocker_text: Admission to an accredited Moldovan educational institution, routed via Ministry of Education/Research approval.
Proof of means (waived for holders of a Moldovan-government scholarship); housing proof; medical insurance; legalized criminal record if the applicant resided abroad 2+ years.

outcome.duration_length: full duration of studies; must report any changes within 15 days

sources.title: Bureau for Migration and Asylum (legacy igm.gov.md domain) -- studies in the Republic of Moldova: admission, housing/insurance/means requirements, legalized criminal record for 2+ years abroad
Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Moldova -- types of visas: D/AS long-stay study visa
